propositions: Two CloudWatch alarms (voter_errors and replication_errors) declare no alarm_actions or ok_actions, so they transition OK→ALARM silently with no notification reaching operators.
The established repo convention wires 11 of 13 alarms to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn for both alarm and ok state transitions; voter_errors and replication_errors are the only two omissions.
The voter_errors alarm is a safety net for the LLM-Review voter that gates all landings on main; silent failure to notify means unsubmittable changes stack up undetected.

A guard test must parse every aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm block in infra/terraform/ and fail on any lacking alarm_actions, with mandatory anti-vacuity assertion (≥13 blocks parsed) and explicit opt-out marker for intentionally silent alarms.
Merging HCL changes does not apply them to AWS; the fix remained un-applied in production until operator ran terraform apply, demonstrating the ticket cannot close on merge alone.
